name: gestionale-gibboni
description: Flowline — Gestionale Termoidraulica Gibboni (React + Vite + PocketBase)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run download --prefix apps/pocketbase
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,db --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix apps/web" "npm run dev --prefix apps/pocketbase"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --prefix apps/pocketbase
